label: One round · ties end in a draw

scope.summary: Choose in secret, reveal together. Three choices form a circle: each defeats one and loses to the other.
includes: Two players, three gestures, one simultaneous reveal and a single-round result
excludes: Match scoring and mandatory tie replays

rules.statement: Choose the gesture that defeats your opponent’s gesture.
Two players face each other. Agree to play exactly one round.

origin.attribution: RuleBooks one-round profile: exactly one simultaneous choice per player, with a draw ending tied play. This is not the WRPSA match format, which replays ties.

rules.statement: Use a closed fist for rock, a flat hand for paper, and two extended fingers for scissors.

citations.locator: Throw Mechanics: The Three Valid Throws

rules.statement: Choose before the reveal and do not show your choice early.
Count together: rock, paper, scissors, shoot. Both reveal on shoot; do not wait to react to the other hand.
If the reveal is mistimed or a gesture is unclear, reset the attempt without scoring it.

origin.attribution: RuleBooks casual-play convention for this one-round profile; not the WRPSA foul schedule.

rules.statement: Rock defeats scissors. Scissors defeats paper. Paper defeats rock.
Matching gestures end this round in a draw. Otherwise, the player with the defeating gesture wins.

origin.attribution: RuleBooks one-round profile: exactly one simultaneous choice per player, with a draw ending tied play. This is not the WRPSA match format, which replays ties.
